name: Reasonix Studio v2.37.0
body:
本版加入常用服务预设库和主题包删除，并修复严格网关回放无参数工具调用时的 HTTP 400、卡住的外壳探测拖住内核等问题。

## 新增

- 添加模型服务时可以从内核维护的常用预设开始：可搜索、按域名分组，选中后整条预设（模型目录、识图模型、窗口、思考档）原样写入，名称重复由内核判断 (#12645)
- 外观里可以删除已安装的主题包，需要点两次确认，内置主题没有删除入口 (#12623)

## 变更

- 删除模型服务时会说明哪些角色改用了其他服务、哪些被清空，并从 `provider_access` 里去掉该服务 (#12589)
- 带密钥的供应商请求（聊天、探测、余额、决策协议）不再跟随跨主机的重定向；被拒时说明被重定向到了哪里，聊天也不再重试十次。如果你的中转站会重定向，把 base URL 改成它重定向到的地址即可 (#12570)
- 每天的第一个回合会告诉模型当天日期，只放在回合末尾，不改变缓存前缀 (#12598)
- `reasonix upgrade` 遇到由 npm 或 Homebrew 安装的程序，会提示用对应的包管理器升级，不再自己替换文件 (#12578)
- 检查通过之后才写入的文档不再要求再验证一次；有工具钩子或边车介入时仍然要求验证 (#12560)

## 修复

- 严格的网关在回放无参数的工具调用时返回 HTTP 400「arguments must be valid JSON」：空参数现在发送 `{}`，已保存的会话保持原样 (#12745)
- 外壳探测整体有时限，一次卡住的探测不再拖住内核，也不会反复重新启动 (#12615)
- 本地 `.mcp.json` 等清单有大小上限，安装被拒时会写明具体原因 (#12641)
- 内部：Windows 更新助手移除、配置迁移合并为一次读取、启动输入显式绑定、测试稳定性 (#12594, #12592, #12555, #12742)

## What's Changed
* fix(providers): keep key-carrying provider requests on the configured origin by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12570
* fix(readiness): prose written after a passing check owes no second run by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12560
* feat(providers): report the roles a removal moved or cleared and prune provider_access by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12589
* feat(control): tell the model the calendar date on the turn tail, once per day by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12598
* feat(providers): offer the kernel's curated presets when adding a source by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12645
* fix(sandbox): bound shell discovery as a whole so a stalled lookup cannot hold the kernel handshake by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12615
* perf(config): run the retired-key migrations over one read of each config by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12592
* fix(installsource): bound a local .mcp.json and name the cause of a refused install by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12641
* perf(boot): bind every storage root Build resolves to its stated home by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12555
* fix(upgrade): leave npm-installed binaries to npm by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12578
* refactor(update): remove the unused Windows update helper from studio by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12594
* feat(studio): delete a theme pack from Appearance by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12623
* fix(provider): replay a tool call with no arguments as an empty object by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12745
* docs(release): Studio 2.37.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12746
* fix(e2ebench): fail mutation and differential analysis when source restoration fails by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12562
* fix(serve): send an empty sessions list for a folder with no conversations by @jipeng6036-del in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

## New Contributors
* @jipeng6036-del made their first contribution in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.36.0...studio-v2.37.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。
